'''''The Lost City of the Jedi''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] junior novel written by [[Paul Davids]] and [[Hollace Davids]], with interior illustrations by [[Karl Kesel]]. It is the sequel to ''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]'', and it is the second volume of the [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince]] series. It was first published by [[Bantam Spectra|Bantam Skylark]] in [[July]] [[1992]], and a sequel, ''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]'', was published later that year. The three books were later collected in ''[[Star Wars: Book One]]'' ([[1997]]).
